notes: "Lawo Ruby" is a modular radio mixing console system with three parts: the 19"/1RU "Power Core" DSP engine (all physical audio/control I/O lives here), one or more "ruby" control-surface fader frames (connect to Power Core via CAN bus only — no audio I/O of their own, powered by their own external 12V DC PSU), and "DisplayDock" GUI software running on a customer-supplied Windows PC. Ports below are the Power Core engine's physical I/O in the "ruby standard configuration" (Slot 1 fitted with STUDIO IO card 710/35, Slot 2 with MIC/LINE IN card 710/20; 6 further expansion slots are optional/empty by default and can add LINE IN, LINE OUT, or AES3 IO cards on further DB-25 or HD-BNC connectors — not included here since unpopulated in the base config). Connector-list gaps: DB-25 (TASCAM/AES59-wired analog & AES3 breakout) has no id in the allowed list, so it is mapped to xlr3 (analog) per this catalog's established convention (see communityCatalog.json AJA entries); the 37-pin D-type GPIO connector is mapped to rs232 as the closest D-sub shape (not actual RS-232); the RS 422 port and CAN port are physically 8-pin RJ45 females (per the manual's Connector Pin-Outs appendix) — RS422 is mapped to the rs422 connector id (protocol match) while CAN is mapped to rj45 (physical-form match, no CAN id exists). The DC power input is a 4-pin Kycon locking connector, mapped to xlr4-dc as the closest 4-pin DC connector id (not literally XLR). AC mains input is stated only as "100-240V AC input" with an IEC power cable; exact IEC C13/C14 inlet is inferred, not explicitly pictured in the manual excerpt reviewed. CONTROL A/B and RAVENNA/AES67 A/B are empty SFP cages — the manual's own certified-module list is all-1000BASE (SX/LX/ZX fiber or T copper), so eth-1g is used; MADI SFP ports (MADI 3/4 not available in standard config) carry no bandwidth-graded connector type in the allowed enum, so grade is omitted. Ruby is now discontinued/EOL, replaced by Lawo diamond — this manual (v6.4.0) remains the most complete authoritative connector reference found.

ports.name: DONGLE
ports.note: Front panel. USB port for the WIBU CodeMeter license dongle (memory-stick style); a safety cap can be fitted. USB version not stated.

ports.name: CAN
ports.note: Front panel, 8-pin RJ45 female (per Connector Pin-Outs appendix). CAN bus link to the ruby control-surface frame(s); not Ethernet.

ports.name: RS 422
ports.note: Front panel. Physically an 8-pin RJ45 female (per Connector Pin-Outs appendix), used as an RS-422 serial port for remote control (e.g. playout systems) or debugging.

ports.name: CONTROL A
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage (module ordered separately). Connects to host PC running DisplayDock. Certified modules are 1000Base-SX/LX/ZX (fiber) or 1000Base-T (RJ45 copper).

ports.name: CONTROL B
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage. Unused/unconnected in the standard configuration (redundant/expansion control port).

ports.name: RAVENNA/AES67 A
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage. AoIP streaming (32 stereo Rx/Tx streams by default), ST2110-30/31 & AES67 compatible. Certified modules are all 1000Base variants.

ports.name: RAVENNA/AES67 B
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage. Unused by default; used only when ST2022-7 redundant streaming is configured.

ports.name: MADI 1
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage. Primary 64-channel MADI (AES10) port. Certified modules: multi-mode/single-mode fiber or HD-BNC coax. No bandwidth-grade id in the allowed enum applies to MADI.

ports.name: MADI 2
ports.note: Front panel, empty SFP cage. Redundant MADI port (optional).

ports.name: WCLK IN
ports.note: Front panel, 75-ohm BNC. External wordclock sync reference input.

ports.name: WCLK OUT
ports.note: Front panel, 75-ohm BNC. Outputs the current system reference clock.

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: Front panel, 37-pin D-type (Sub-D37) female. 8x GPI (optocoupler inputs) + 8x GPO (relay outputs). No 37-pin D-sub id in the allowed list; mapped to rs232 as the closest D-sub shape (not actual RS-232 serial).

ports.name: STUDIO IO Mic/Line In (Slot 1)
ports.note: Rear panel, Slot 1 (STUDIO IO card 710/35), 25-pin DB-25 female wired per AES59/TASCAM standard, carrying 2 mono Mic/Line inputs. DB-25 has no id in the allowed connector list; mapped to xlr3 as closest per this catalog's convention.

ports.name: STUDIO IO Line Out (Slot 1)
ports.note: Rear panel, Slot 1 (STUDIO IO card 710/35), same DB-25 as above, 1 stereo Line output pair.

ports.name: STUDIO IO Headphone Out (Slot 1)
ports.note: Rear panel, Slot 1 (STUDIO IO card 710/35), same DB-25 connector, 2 stereo headphone outputs — pinning differs from the AES59/TASCAM standard used for the rest of this card.

ports.name: MIC/LINE IN (Slot 2)
ports.note: Rear panel, Slot 2 (MIC/LINE IN card 710/20), 25-pin DB-25 female wired per AES59/TASCAM standard, carrying 8 mono Mic/Line inputs with variable preamp gain, switchable 48V phantom, HPF and 20dB pad.

ports.name: AC Mains Input
ports.note: Rear panel, integrated wide-ranging 100-240V AC supply, supplied 2m IEC power cable. Exact inlet variant (C13/C14) inferred, not explicitly specified in the source manual.

ports.name: 12V DC Input
ports.note: Rear panel. Physically a 4-pin Kycon locking connector (per Connector Pin-Outs appendix), for the optional external 12V DC redundant power supply (955/50-80). Mapped to xlr4-dc as the closest 4-pin locking DC connector id; not a true XLR.
